definitions.outcomes: Real food arrivals in the evaluation interval (including unavailable food with reward zero).
definitions.normal: Original glyph received. Sender and listener learn online.
definitions.muted: Sender still chooses a glyph or silence and gets local feedback; listeners receive no glyph. Replay learns independently from tick zero.
definitions.permuted: Independently permute glyph identities at each contact, without changing silence; online learners are retained.
definitions.changedChoices: At the actual departure, mask only that listener’s glyph in the frozen state and reuse the same exploration and tie-breaking draws. Count a changed destination; the alternative was not executed.
definitions.contextStability: For sender–receiver–latest site–reward sign contexts with eight or more observed contact actions in both intervals, count contexts with the same non-silent modal action at 60% or more in both. Includes silence in the denominator and measures sender behavior, not listener decoding.
